narrative.headline: 2018 Jeep Compass: engine and electrical issues dominate owner complaints
narrative.summary: Across 923 owner complaints to NHTSA, engine problems lead by a wide margin at 463 reports (50%), followed by electrical system issues at 368 (40%). Engine and power train each tie for the most crashes (7 apiece), and the electrical system saw the most fires (3). Reported injuries are low overall, with no deaths.
